==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand wakes up and gives orders the rulers to be gathered in one hour at the center of the Field of Merrilor. He talks with [[Aviendha]] about the [[Age of Legends]] and their ways, demonstrating how they used channeling for taking a shower. Aviendha tells Rand she will require a boon that may force Rand to change his plans in a drastic way.

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
Egwene dreams of a frozen pillar of glass. She also dreams about a sphere (the world) cracking and how she was tying it with cords, trying to hold it together which takes a monumental effort. Egwene wakes up in the White Tower and talks with [[Gawyn Trakand|Gawyn]] who she finds reading a report about [[Caemlyn]]. Together they go through a [[Gateways|gateway]] to Egwene's tent on the Field of Merrilor. They go out and head to the meeting place together with [[Silviana Brehon|Silviana]] and a number of Sitters. Egwene speaks with [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]], [[Darlin Sisnera|Darlin]], and [[Gregorin den Lushenos|Gregorin]]. King [[Roedran Almaric do Arreloa a'Naloy|Roedran]] of Murandy then arrives unexpectedly. He says he is interested in seeing this "false [[Dragon]]" for himself and Egwene pries out of him that Elayne promised not to invade his lands if he supported "her cause." Rand finally arrives, the grass greening under his feet, and constructs a massive pavilion with the One Power. As he enters the pavilion, he proclaims that every ruler can bring five people with them. Egwene chooses Silviana, [[Saerin Asnobar|Saerin]], [[Romanda Cassin|Romanda]], [[Lelaine Akashi|Lelaine]] and Gawyn. All of them enter the pavilion erected in the center of the field, with [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar|King Alsalam]] of [[Arad Doman]] making an appearance to Egwene's surprise. Rand welcomes them and tells them they need a plan to fight the Shadow and they need to plan for what happens after. The [[Aiel]] [[Clan chief|clan chiefs]] and [[Wise One|Wise Ones]] entered en masse and many make their way to Egwene's side instead of Rand's, which appears to upset Rand. Rand initially walks up to Roedran, who has been followed by several [[Asha'man]], and appears to take a closer look. He then waves him away saying under his breath "where are you?!" as Rand had believed Roedran may have been [[Demandred]] in disguise. He explains that in the [[Age of Legends]] they understood the [[One Power]] more and were able to manipulate it better than they can now and even then, they barely won against the [[Dark One]]. He then says he won't die again just so humanity could continue fighting each other. The Dragon requires three things as payment for his life: 
* The first requirement is for the borders to be set as they are at that moment. This means prohibiting countries to attack each other, opening of state funded schools in each capital, and obligations for the other countries to defend one under attack. 
* The second requirement is the breaking of the [[Seven Seals|seals]] to the [[Dark One]]'s Prison, which Egwene strongly opposes. Rand tells her he intends to try killing the Dark One, making sure no other Age has to suffer what they have. 
* Rand's third requirement is to be commander of the world's armies during [[Tarmon Gai'don]]. He cites the lack of unity during the [[War of Power|War of the Power]] as the reason for their defeat.
As the rulers argue about the requirements, Rand and Egwene begin an argument about the seals. Rand then reveals he wants to kill, or attempt to kill, the Dark One and Egwene calls him insane. As tensions in the pavilion rise and Rand is about to leave, [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] enters.
